topic.readerProblem: Determine whether Scrunch Core prompt, audit, workspace, user and engine limits fit a repeatable brand or agency workflow.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer evaluating prompt monitoring plus site-audit capacity for AI-search visibility.

assessment: The final guide keeps Brands and Agencies pricing separate, explains the one-workspace boundary, and qualifies the nominal US$2 per prompt-month ratio as a utilization aid rather than a unit price. No accuracy, refresh or multi-client behavior is invented.
